verdict.rationale: Fivetran documents orchestration of transformations in the destination. Transformations can run automatically after their upstream connection syncs, which is a built-in sync→transform dependency, and dbt Core projects can be hosted alongside third-party dbt Cloud/Coalesce orchestration. The evidence does not show a general facility for declaring dependencies between arbitrary pipeline steps and datasets, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: explicit user-defined DAG or dependency definitions across steps and datasets, documentation of dataset-level dependency ordering, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the orchestration behavior.
